title: 第18章
content:
这语气，何其嚣张！谁能不气？可他说的是事实，现场压根没人敢跟他硬刚！场面顿时乱做一片，冷老爷子气得浑身哆嗦，任晓兰跟冷晓月两人还想上去拦，却被这帮混账一把挥开，跌倒在地！冷老爷子重重的敲了两下地面：“够了！”听着周遭女眷的惊呼，他神色沉了下去，“这位小兄弟，看在我老头子的面子上，今天你能不能……”“滚，你个死老头有什么面子？！”黄哥抬手就要把冷老爷子挥开！明川眼神倏地一冷，身形一闪快速上前，稳住老爷子的同时，扼住了黄哥的手腕！他指尖一个用力，黄哥手腕骨头登时咔咔作响！“哥们儿，动谁可以，动老人家，你有点没公德心了。”“屮，你……”黄哥额角青筋暴起，眼睛瞪大，手腕钻心的疼。那只被明川紧握着的手，根本半分动弹不得！这，这怎么可能？！边上冷家众人也都看傻了眼。冷希面容冷峻，轻声道：“明川，这是孙韶华自己的事，你不用管。”冷老爷子也跟着附和：“孙婿啊，我知道你是担心老头子我受伤，没事，这群人不敢动我的。”当然，除了这两人由衷的显出几分担忧之外，其余众人倒是都乐得看明川被人收拾的模样。他们个个眼里冒着讥讽，尤其是现在被翻转局面狠狠打脸的冷晓月和任晓兰母女二人！她俩后槽牙都快咬碎了，就恨不得现在黄哥就立马将明川碾压成沫！可他们哪能想得到，现在压根就不是黄哥不想动，而是他不能动啊！黄哥眼里登时冒出几分惶恐，但他不信邪，朝着周围几个小弟啐了一声：“你们等什么，动手啊，给老子弄死这小子！”几个高头大马的男人见势不对，迅速抄起一旁椅子朝明川砸去！他们眼里闪着凶狠，大有今天不弄死此人不罢休的气势！可“轰”的一声巨响过后，周遭尘烟四起，众人一颗心都跟着提到嗓子眼来！他们还以为是那群混混力气太大，直接用椅子在明川身上盖了个粉碎！下一刻，众人定睛一看，全都惊呆了！因为先前那灰尘，竟然是明川一拳将那椅子干了个粉碎！明川嘴角勾起笑，冷嗤道：“老爷子，你身体是没事儿，不过这群人当着我的面扫你的面子，是找死！”孙韶华气笑了，这明川知不知道自己在说什么，他怎么敢这么狂的！？“乡巴佬，你别以为你有几分蛮力……”轰轰轰！孙韶华话音未落，几个混混反应过来迅猛扛着各种家伙式朝明川砸去，期间还夹杂着他们爆裂的拳风！这一拳下去，若是孙韶华，至少会将他打成半身不遂！可接连三声爆炸响起，却只见明川随手抡起那黄哥，朝着他们一行人横扫而去！“啊！！！”几道惨叫声同时从这群混混口中吐出，十几个家伙登时犹如保龄球一般被打飞出去！直直倒飞出几米远，撞上墙壁才堪堪停下！黄哥“噗”的吐出一大口鲜血，将自己脸上染得通红，还弄得底下小弟满身是血！这一幕，看呆了宴会场上的所有人！

而接下来更令人诧异的是。明川傲然自立，双手背在身后，眼神蔑视的看着他们：“我只用了不到一成的力，识相的现在就给我滚。再敢打扰老爷子寿辰，别怪我不客气。”嚣张，太嚣张了！这不得站起来立马弄死这小子？！可这群小混混闻言，顿时如雷贯耳，一边吐血一边连滚带爬的从地上翻起身往外逃。这速度，这场面……脚底抹油也不过如此！可即便如此，他们也不忘朝着明川放狠话。“老子记住你了，你给我等着！”说罢，这群人一个闪身飞奔上车，油门一轰，两秒就没影了！只留下一地的狼藉给冷家众人！这群人震惊，齐齐将视线转移向明川。只见明川淡定的拍了拍手上的灰，早就习惯了。他随意的转头，笑盈盈的看向冷老爷子：“老爷子，您没事儿吧？”冷老爷子愣住，木讷的摇了摇头：“没有……”转瞬间，这老人家那双灰暗的眼眸都变得满是希冀！这孙婿太顶了，帅啊！他连忙戳了戳冷希，骄傲的扬着下巴朝着众人扫视一圈：“一群缩头乌龟，只会欺软怕硬。”“先前嘲讽我孙婿那么起劲，怎么刚才没人敢出来表个态啊？”此话一出，众人都宛如吃了苍蝇一般难受！他们竟然被最瞧不起的乡下狗打脸了！冷希也悠悠的挽上明川的胳膊：“不错，懂得维护爷爷，不像是某些人，只会给爷爷添麻烦。丢人。”冷晓月脸色一黑，狠狠瞪了孙韶华一眼，随即又抬头看向老爷子，讽刺道：“爷爷，您老糊涂了吧？一个只会用蛮力的乡下人，有什么好值得炫耀的？”“韶华只是一时资金紧张，可现在这土包子随意动手，甚至还打了东爷的人！这样一来，咱们冷家算是彻底惹上东爷这位大人物了！”冷晓月一番话，将众人都说得恍然大悟，登时每个人看向明川的眼神里都充满了厌恶。要知道那东爷可是个赶尽杀绝的狠货！“就是啊！老爷子，您这是连带着把我们都害了啊！”“年纪大了真是老糊涂了！”见这群人丑恶嘴脸，冷希面容一僵，玉手忍不住捏紧。就连冷老爷子的笑也不由得凝固了几分。他们说的，倒的确是事实……“那又如何？”冷希倏地开口，鄙夷的看向孙韶华道：“总比这怂包好。”“我相信，即便是之后东爷来闹事，明川也能再次解决！”这话说得掷地有声。明川替她维护了冷家场面，她自然也不能让他白白受这群人奚落。之后想办法送东爷点好处，他不至于咬死不放。念及至此，冷希暗自紧攥住了明川的手，暗示他不要再像之前那样大吹牛皮，接下来交给她就行了。可明川压根儿就没感觉啊。“不错，什么东爷西爷的，都得给咱磕一个。”冷希：……

This tone is so arrogant!Who can not be angry?But what he said was true. No one dared to confront him!The scene suddenly became chaotic. Mr. Leng was trembling with anger. Ren Xiaolan and Leng Xiaoyue wanted to stop them, but they were waved away by these bastards and fell to the ground!Old man Leng knocked on the ground twice: "That's enough!" Hearing the exclamations of the women around him, his expression darkened, "Little brother, for the sake of my old man, can you today..." "Get out, what kind of face do you have, you damn old man?!" Brother Huang raised his hand to wave old man Leng away!Mingchuan's eyes suddenly turned cold, and he stepped forward quickly. While steadying the old man, he strangled Brother Huang's wrist!He exerted force with his fingertips, and the bones of Brother Huang's wrist immediately cracked!"Brother, you can touch whoever you want, but you are a bit unethical when you touch an old man." "Hey, you..." Veins popped up on Brother Huang's forehead, his eyes widened, and his wrists hurt terribly.The hand held tightly by Mingchuan could not move at all!This, how is this possible?!Everyone in the Leng family nearby was also dumbfounded.Leng hope looked stern and said softly: "Mingchuan, this is Sun Shaohua's own business, you don't have to worry about it." Mr. Leng also echoed: "Son-in-law, I know you are worried about the old man and me getting hurt. It's okay. These people don't dare to touch me." Of course, except for these two people who showed some sincere concern, the rest of the people were happy to see Mingchuan being dealt with.There was sarcasm in their eyes, especially the mother and daughter Leng Xiaoyue and Ren Xiaolan who were now being slapped in the face by the situation being reversed!Both of their back molars were almost broken, and they wished that Brother Huang would crush Mingchuan into pieces right now!But how could they have imagined that it wasn't that Brother Huang didn't want to move, but that he couldn't move!Brother Huang's eyes suddenly showed a bit of fear, but he did not believe in evil and spat at the boys around him: "What are you waiting for? Take action and kill this kid for me!" Seeing that something was wrong, several tall men quickly picked up a chair and threw it at Mingchuan!There was fierceness in their eyes, and they had the momentum to stop until this person was killed today!But after a loud "boom", dust and smoke were everywhere, and everyone's hearts were in their throats!They thought that those gangsters were too strong, so they used chairs to cover Mingchuan to pieces!The next moment, everyone took a closer look and were all shocked!Because of the dust before, it was Mingchuan who punched the chair to pieces!The corners of Mingchuan's lips curled up into a smile, and he sneered coldly: "Old man, your health is fine, but these people are seeking death by trying to shame you in front of me!" Sun Shaohua laughed angrily. Does Mingchuan know what he is talking about? How dare he be so crazy!?"Hillbilly, don't think you have any brute strength..." Boom boom boom!Before Sun Shaohua finished speaking, several gangsters reacted and quickly threw various blows at Mingchuan, with their explosive fists mixed in during the process!With this punch, if it were Sun Shaohua, he would at least be paralyzed!But three explosions were heard in succession, and Mingchuan was seen casually picking up Brother Huang and sweeping towards the group of them!"Ah!!!" Several screams came out from the mouths of this group of gangsters at the same time, and a dozen guys were immediately knocked out like bowling balls!It flew several meters away and hit a wall before stopping!Brother Huang spat out a large mouthful of blood, staining his face red and making his younger brother covered in blood!This scene stunned everyone at the banquet!

What’s next is even more surprising.Mingchuan was proud and self-reliant, with his hands behind his back and looking at them with contempt: "I only used less than 10% of my strength. If you are wise, get out of here now. If you dare to disturb the old man's birthday again, don't blame me for being rude." Arrogant, too arrogant!Why don't you stand up and kill this kid immediately?!But when this group of gangsters heard this, they suddenly became thunderous. They vomited blood and rolled up from the ground to escape.This speed, this scene... oiling the soles of your feet is nothing more than that!But even so, they did not forget to speak harsh words towards Mingchuan."I remember you, just wait for me!" After saying that, the group of people jumped into the car and quickly disappeared in two seconds!Only a mess was left for everyone in the Leng family!The group of people were shocked and all turned their attention to Mingchuan.I saw Mingchuan calmly patting the dust on his hands, he had long been used to it.He turned his head casually and looked at Mr. Leng with a smile: "Old man, are you okay?" Mr. Leng was stunned and shook his head dullly: "No..." In an instant, the old man's gray eyes became full of hope!This grandson-in-law is so awesome, so handsome!He quickly poked Leng Xi, raised his chin proudly and glanced around at everyone: "A bunch of shy turtles, they only bully the weak and shy away from the strong." "You were so enthusiastic about teasing my grandson-in-law before, why didn't anyone dare to come out and express their opinions just now?" As soon as these words came out, everyone felt as if they had eaten flies!They were slapped in the face by the most despised country dog!Leng Xi also took Mingchuan's arm leisurely: "Yes, you know how to protect grandpa, unlike some people who only cause trouble for grandpa. It's embarrassing." Leng Xiaoyue's face darkened, she glared at Sun Shaohua, then raised her head to look at the old man, and said sarcastically: "Grandpa, are you confused? A countryman who can only use brute force, what's the point?Is it worth showing off?"Shaohua was just short of funds for a while, but now this country bumpkin has taken action at will and even beaten Mr. Dong's people! In this way, our Leng family has completely offended Mr. Dong!"Leng Xiaoyue's words made everyone suddenly realize, and everyone looked at Mingchuan with disgust.You know, that Master Dong is a ruthless guy who wants to kill everyone!"That's right! Old man, you've harmed us all!" "You're really old and stupid now that you're old!" Seeing the ugly faces of these people, Leng hope's face froze and she couldn't help but squeeze her hands tightly.Even Mr. Leng's smile couldn't help but freeze a bit.What they said is indeed true... "So what?" Leng Xi said quickly, looking at Sun Shaohua with disdain and said: "It's better than this coward." "I believe that even if Mr. Dong comes to make trouble in the future, Mingchuan can solve it again!" These words were loud and clear.Mingchuan had maintained the situation in the Leng family for her, so naturally she couldn't let him suffer the ridicule of this group of people in vain.Then I will find a way to give Dongye some benefits so that he will not bite me to death.Thinking of this, Leng hope secretly squeezed Mingchuan's hand tightly, hinting that he should stop bragging like before and just leave it to her.But Mingchuan didn't feel anything at all."That's right, I have to give you a thumbs-up for everyone." Leng hope:...
